name: ef-slider
description: Slider contract on Exposure/Contrast/Clarity: soft pin, typing grammar, double-click resets, arrows, Escape, option-scroll, fine drag.

steps.note: drag far past the right end of the track
drag pins at the soft limit +5
typing 8 over a pre-selected readout gives 8 (no clear)
typed '* 2': * 2 clamps to the hard limit 10
double-click the Exposure track away from the thumb
one undo after a track double-click brings back exactly 2.00
single click on the Contrast label to focus the row
after Escape, arrows no longer nudge
scrub the Contrast number 20% of the row width

name: ef-undo-tools
description: Undo/redo across WB, exposure, crop angle, linear mask, heal spot, rating, Auto Tone and Reset; recipe and sidecar after each.

name: ef-history-snap
description: History card row clicks and a named snapshot save/restore/undo, reached by OCR.

steps.note: scroll the develop column to the bottom
jump forward to the newest row

name: ef-merge
description: Undo merge window: pairs of Contrast arrow nudges 0.5/1.0/1.6/3.0 s apart, quick typed values, two quick drags.

name: ef-subset
description: Copy Settings… default and custom ticks, plain Copy, Paste Without Masks, Paste Includes Spot Removal, Paste Masks — each copied, Reset, pasted back onto the same photo.

name: ef-paste
description: Copy/Paste Settings variants, Copy Settings… default subset, Paste from Previous, between the A7 IV ARW and the 5D CR2.

name: ef-multi
description: Editing with three photos selected: exposure drag, a mask, crop angle, heal spot; then undo and redo.

name: ef-presets
description: Temp As-Shot resets, Auto and Reset on a RAW, a develop preset saved and applied and undone, Sync Settings… defaults.

steps.note: double-click Temp label returns to As Shot
double-click Temp track returns to As Shot
